# Anne Shirley

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Gilbert Blythe  <sub>[v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v3 c41 P39](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with large, expressive gray-green eyes and a pale, clear complexion. Her hair, famously red during her early childhood, darkened over time to an attractive auburn shade. She possesses delicate features, a pointed chin, and a naturally graceful, expressive presence.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c27 P42](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0042), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, romantic, and deeply passionate individual who experiences life with intense emotion. She possesses a lively sense of humor, a poetic view of nature, and an intense loyalty to her friends. Though hot-tempered and impulsive in her youth, she matures into a thoughtful, empathetic, and hardworking young woman. She holds high ideals for herself and those she loves, constantly striving for self-improvement and spiritual beauty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P5](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0005), [v2 c7 P15](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0015), [v2 c14 P29](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0029), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## History

Anne Shirley was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to schoolteacher parents who both died of fever shortly after her birth. Raised in hardship by various foster families and an orphan asylum, she was mistakenly brought to Green Gables in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, who had wanted a boy. Despite the mistake, they decided to keep her. Anne quickly formed a passionate, lifelong friendship with her neighbor Diana Barry. She attended Avonlea school, where an academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe began after he called her 'Carrots' and she smashed her slate over his head. Anne excelled in her studies, eventually tying with Gilbert for first place on the Island-wide entrance exams for Queen's Academy. After a year at Queen's, she won the Avery Scholarship, but gave up going to college to stay at Green Gables and teach at Avonlea when Matthew died and Marilla's eyesight threatened to fail. During her two years as a beloved Avonlea schoolma'am, Anne organized the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, helped raise the orphaned Keith twins at Green Gables, and formed a deep friendship with the romantic Miss Lavendar Lewis. When Marilla's friend Mrs. Rachel Lynde came to live at Green Gables, Anne was able to resume her studies and attended Redmond College in Kingsport alongside Gilbert, Priscilla Grant, and new friend Philippa Gordon. At Redmond, Anne was courted by the wealthy, handsome Roy Gardner, but eventually realized he was not her true ideal and rejected his proposal. Returning home after graduating with High Honors in English, Anne suffered through a night of anguish when Gilbert fell dangerously ill with typhoid fever, realizing then that she loved him.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c26 P22](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0022), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c36 P12](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0012), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c40 P15](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0015), [v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024)_
